name: Laughlin AFB
description: Home of the 47th Flying Training Wing. Laughlin AFB conducts specialized undergraduate pilot training along the Rio Grande, training hundreds of pilots annually.

currentNotifications.title: REAL ID Required for Base Access
currentNotifications.body: A REAL ID-compliant driver's license or equivalent is required for base access per DHS mandate.

gates.name: West Gate (Main Gate)
gates.address: West Gate, Spur 317, Laughlin AFB, TX 78840

gates.name: North Gate
gates.notes: Limited outbound traffic only. Closed weekends.

gates.name: Visitor Control Center (Bldg 7002)
gates.hours: Mon-Fri 0700-1600; closed weekends and federal holidays
gates.notes: Day passes and visitor registration. REAL ID required. Located at SS317N.

resources.name: Losano Dining Facility
resources.description: Primary DFAC supporting pilot training squadrons with full meal service.

resources.name: Laughlin Main Exchange (BX)
resources.description: Full-service Exchange with retail, services, and food court options.

resources.name: Border Federal Credit Union
resources.description: Full-service credit union branch on base with ATM.

resources.name: Losano Fitness Center
resources.description: Main fitness facility with cardio, weights, group exercise, indoor lap pool, and aerobics classes.
resources.address: Bldg 362, Mitchell Blvd, Laughlin AFB, TX 78840

resources.name: Unaccompanied Housing / Dorm Management
resources.description: Dormitory management and assignments for student pilots and permanent party.

resources.name: Laughlin Manor (AF Lodging)
resources.description: Official temporary lodging and TLF. 24-hour front desk for arrivals. Includes DVQ and TLF.
resources.address: Bldg 454, 4th and Arnold Streets, Laughlin AFB, TX 78840

resources.name: Military & Family Readiness Center (M&FRC)
resources.description: Relocation assistance, financial counseling, employment support, school liaison, and family programs. Pre-Arrival Orientation available.
resources.address: Bldg 362, Mitchell Blvd, Laughlin AFB, TX 78840

resources.name: 47th Force Support Squadron (FSS)
resources.description: Full MWR, dining, fitness, lodging, recreation, and family support programs.
resources.hours: See directory for individual facility hours

resources.name: Outdoor Recreation
resources.description: Equipment rental, Southwinds Marina, and recreational programs.

resources.name: Laughlin Golf Course
resources.description: 18-hole golf course with pro shop and dining.

resources.name: 47th Medical Group
resources.description: Primary care, specialty clinics, and TRICARE services.

sections.title: Required Documents
sections.body: PCS orders, CAC, medical/dental records, marriage and birth certificates if applicable, and travel receipts for finance settlement.

sections.title: Housing
sections.body: Contact Laughlin Manor (830-298-5731) for initial arrival. Dormitory Management for unaccompanied housing. Family housing through Balfour Beatty Communities.

sections.title: Quick Resources
sections.body: 47 FSS, M&FRC, and official Laughlin sites for in-processing and pilot training support.
